<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fixes #63844. On the V2 model runner, a hybrid Mamba/GDN target with prefix caching off and a drafter whose `max_model_len` is shorter fails config validation with `--mamba-block-size can only be set with --enable-prefix-caching`, a flag the user never set. This moves `_limit_max_model_len_to_draft()` (added in #63251) ahead of `try_verify_and_update_config()`, so the model config hooks see the lowered `max_model_len`.
## Claims

- The config from #63844 builds on the V2 runner: `max_model_len` is lowered to the draft's 1024 (as #63251 intends) and `mamba_block_size` follows it, instead of raising.
- V1 runner behavior is unchanged (`max_model_len` stays 4096).
- No other `tests/config` result changes.

## Validation

New test `test_draft_limit_reaches_mamba_block_size` in `tests/config/test_speculative_draft_limits_max_model_len.py` (the reporter's reproducer, CPU only), on main `70d67f19d`:

```
# test only, without the fix
$ pytest tests/config/test_speculative_draft_limits_max_model_len.py
FAILED ...::test_draft_limit_reaches_mamba_block_size[True]
E   pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for VllmConfig
    Value error, --mamba-block-size can only be set with --enable-prefix-caching
1 failed, 5 passed

# with the fix (plus the #63251 position-embedding tests)
$ pytest tests/config/test_speculative_draft_limits_max_model_len.py tests/config/test_speculative_draft_max_position_embeddings.py
21 passed
```

The CLI path from the issue (`EngineArgs(...).create_engine_config()`, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, `ai21labs/Jamba-tiny-random` with a `draft_model` drafter at `max_model_len=1024`, prefix caching off) now returns `max_model_len=1024, mamba_block_size=1024`.

Full `pytest tests/config` (what the `(CPU) Multimodal + Config` step runs), CPU only: 321 passed / 5 failed on main, 323 passed / the same 5 failed with the fix. The 5 failures are environment-only on this machine (3 gated `meta-llama` configs without an HF token; `test_ray_runtime_env` and `test_mp_reducer` start an engine and had no GPU).

End to end on 1x H200 NVL, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, same config through `LLM(...)` (`load_format="dummy"`, greedy, 16 tokens):

| | main `70d67f19d` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| engine start | `ValidationError: --mamba-block-size can only be set with --enable-prefix-caching` | starts; `max_model_len=1024`, `mamba_block_size=1024` |
| generate | n/a | 16 tokens |

<details>
<summary>Script</summary>

```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

llm = LLM(
    model="ai21labs/Jamba-tiny-random",
    max_model_len=4096,
    enable_prefix_caching=False,
    load_format="dummy",
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.2,
    speculative_config={"method": "draft_model", "model": "ai21labs/Jamba-tiny-random",
                        "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "max_model_len": 1024},
)
c = llm.llm_engine.vllm_config
print("CONFIG max_model_len", c.model_config.max_model_len, "mamba_block_size", c.cache_config.mamba_block_size)
out = llm.generate(["Hello, my name is"], SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=16))
print("GENERATED", len(out[0].outputs[0].token_ids), "tokens")
```
</details>

## Details

`VllmConfig.__post_init__` ran `try_verify_and_update_config()` first and `_limit_max_model_len_to_draft()` later. For hybrid models with prefix caching off, the hook in `HybridAttentionMambaModelConfig` sets `cache_config.mamba_block_size = model_config.max_model_len` (4096). The draft limit then lowers `max_model_len` to 1024, and `validate_mamba_block_size` reads `mamba_block_size != max_model_len` as "the user set `--mamba-block-size`" and raises. Any other hook deriving a value from `max_model_len` also saw the stale value.

Running the draft limit before the hooks fixes this at the source instead of patching `mamba_block_size` afterwards. Its inputs (`use_v2_model_runner`, the draft config, `draft_shares_target_positions()`) are not changed by the model config hooks. The only hook that writes `max_model_len` (EmbeddingGemma2) caps it at 8192, which still composes with a lower draft limit. The check stays after the submodel-config early return, as before.

**Limitation / possible follow-up.** The root fragility is in `validate_mamba_block_size`: it infers "the user passed `--mamba-block-size`" from `mamba_block_size != max_model_len`, so any change to either value after the hybrid hook ran makes it fire on a value the hook set itself. #52045 works around the same validator firing from a different trigger (CPU MLA disabling prefix caching after the hook ran). A sturdier fix would record whether `mamba_block_size` was user-set and validate only that, but it touches how `CacheConfig` tracks explicit arguments, so I kept this PR to the ordering fix. Happy to do that as a separate PR if maintainers prefer it.

@@ -11,10 +11,17 @@
 
 import pytest
 
-from vllm.config import ModelConfig, ParallelConfig, SpeculativeConfig, VllmConfig
+from vllm.config import (
+    CacheConfig,
+    ModelConfig,
+    ParallelConfig,
+    SpeculativeConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+)
 
 # All repos are public; only config/tokenizer-config files are fetched.
 AR_MODEL = "JackFram/llama-68m"  # max_position_embeddings=2048
+HYBRID_MODEL = "ai21labs/Jamba-tiny-random"
 EAGLE3_DRAFT = "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B"  # max_position_embeddings=2048
 LLAMA3_TARGET = "unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"  # max_position_embeddings=131072
 
@@ -71,3 +78,30 @@ def test_eagle_draft_limits_max_model_len_unless_resized(
     draft_hf_config = speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
     assert draft_hf_config.max_position_embeddings == (8192 if resizable else 2048)
     assert vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len == (8192 if resizable else 2048)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_v2_model_runner", [True, False])
+def test_draft_limit_reaches_mamba_block_size(
+    use_v2_model_runner: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    """Without prefix caching, the hybrid mamba hook sets mamba_block_size to
+    max_model_len; it must see the value the draft lowered it to (#63844)."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", str(int(use_v2_model_runner)))
+    model_config = ModelConfig(HYBRID_MODEL, max_model_len=4096)
+    speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+        target_model_config=model_config,
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        model=HYBRID_MODEL,
+        method="draft_model",
+        num_speculative_tokens=3,
+        max_model_len=1024,
+    )
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model_config,
+        speculative_config=speculative_config,
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(enable_prefix_caching=False),
+    )
+    expected = 1024 if use_v2_model_runner else 4096
+    assert vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len == expected
+    assert vllm_config.cache_config.mamba_block_size == expected

         if self.performance_mode != "balanced":
             logger.info_once("Performance mode set to '%s'.", self.performance_mode)
